reason: B offers the more physically coherent and testable mechanism: heat-treatment-induced nanotwins/recrystallized grains and retained dislocations increase hardness, while higher-temperature recrystallization and coarsening reduce it, consistent with the cited analogous coating evidence. A adds unsupported Cr2O3 formation during vacuum annealing and oxide instability as governing mechanisms, although neither is established by the evidence and substantial oxide growth in vacuum is questionable.
